FN-U961AGG-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 24
Committee: Ways and Means Education Sponsor: Representative Ed Oliver
Analyst: John Friedenreich Date: 02/21/2025
House Bill 24 as introduced could increase the obligations of the Volunteer Rescue Squad
Tuition Reimbursement Program by an undetermined amount dependent on any tuition paid for
attendance at any educational institutions that become eligible pursuant to this bill that would
otherwise be ineligible under current law.
This bill could also increase the administrative obligations of the Alabama Community College
System (ACCS) to administer the new provisions of this program as provided by this bill.
Page 1

FN-U961AGG-2
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 24
Committee: Ways and Means Education Sponsor: Representative Ed Oliver
Analyst: John Friedenreich Date: 02/26/2025
House Bill 24 as reported by the Committee on Ways and Means Education could increase the
obligations of the Volunteer Rescue Squad Tuition Reimbursement Program by an
undetermined amount dependent on any tuition paid for attendance at any educational
institutions that become eligible pursuant to this bill that would otherwise be ineligible under
current law. The increase could be offset, in part or in whole, by the monetary cap, set by the
Alabama Department of Public Health, on the amount of tuition costs that may be reimbursed
under the program, which may not exceed any cap in effect on the tuition costs for the Alabama
Fire College.
This bill could also increase the administrative obligations of the Alabama Community College
System (ACCS) to administer the new provisions of this program and the Alabama Department
of Public Health to adopt rules setting certain credentialing and accreditation standards, as
provided by this bill.
